svg.title: compose-new-comment · preview · 100x30
svg.text: Agreed, and I think the README should say so explicitly. Here's what I'd add under Keys:
move one line and stop at either end of the file; they never wrap around.
jumps to the last line and
move by hunk, and stop at the first and the last hunk.
I also checked the three cases you listed against the current build. All three behave as
described, so I don't think we need a code change here, just the docs. If you want, I
can open a follow-up for the wrap-around idea, since a few people asked for it in the
discussion, but I'd keep it behind a setting so the default stays the same as today.
One more thing: the help panel lists
as "Line down" but the footer says "Down". We
should pick one. I'd go with the help panel's wording because it's more specific, and
the footer has room for it at 100 columns.
Open a file longer than the screen
on a file with three hunks
